name: TI Arm Clang
description: Installs the TI Arm Clang compiler toolchain for Sitara MCU development.

version.description: TI Arm Clang version. Override installerUrl/sha256 (and arm64InstallerUrl/arm64Sha256 on arm64) when changing this value.

installerUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the Linux x64 TI Arm Clang installer.

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the Linux x64 installer.

arm64InstallerUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the Linux arm64 TI Arm Clang installer.

arm64Sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the Linux arm64 installer. Required when building on linux/arm64.
